files.patch:
Index: /tmp/opencode/kbtest.sh
===================================================================
--- /tmp/opencode/kbtest.sh
+++ /tmp/opencode/kbtest.sh
@@ -1,24 +1,28 @@
 #!/bin/bash
-OUT=/tmp/opencode/keytest.out; rm -f "$OUT"
-setsid nohup alacritty --class keytest -T KEYTESTX -e sh -c 'stty -icanon -isig -echo min 0; timeout 20 cat -v' >"$OUT" 2>/tmp/opencode/keytest.err &
+# Замер байтов от Ctrl+буква US vs RU в Alacritty (X11). Захват внутри pty: cat > file.
+BIN=/tmp/opencode/keys.bin
+rm -f "$BIN"
+alacritty --class keytest -o window.dynamic_title=false -e \
+  sh -c 'stty -icanon -isig -echo min 0; timeout 18 cat > /tmp/opencode/keys.bin' \
+  >/dev/null 2>&1 &
 wid=""
-for i in $(seq 1 20); do
-  wid=$(xdotool search --name KEYTESTX 2>/dev/null | tail -1)
+for i in $(seq 1 24); do
+  wid=$(xdotool search --class keytest 2>/dev/null | tail -1)
   [ -n "$wid" ] && break
   sleep 0.5
 done
-echo "wid=$wid pgrep=$(pgrep -fa 'KEYTESTX|class keytest' | grep -c alacritty)"
-[ -z "$wid" ] && { cat /tmp/opencode/keytest.err; exit 1; }
+[ -z "$wid" ] && { echo "NO_WINDOW"; exit 1; }
 xdotool windowactivate --sync "$wid"; sleep 0.7
-setxkbmap -layout us; sleep 0.3
-xdotool key ctrl+a;  sleep 0.4
-xdotool key ctrl+x;  sleep 0.4
+setxkbmap -layout us;  sleep 0.3
+xdotool key ctrl+a;  sleep 0.4          # эталон US: 01
+xdotool key ctrl+x;  sleep 0.4          # эталон US: 18
 setxkbmap -layout ru; sleep 0.3
-xdotool key ctrl+cyrillic_de;  sleep 0.4
-xdotool key ctrl+cyrillic_check; sleep 0.4
-xdotool key ctrl+cyrillic_te;  sleep 0.4
-xdotool key cyrillic_ef;       sleep 0.4
+xdotool key ctrl+cyrillic_de;  sleep 0.4  # RU физ.A (ф)
+xdotool key ctrl+cyrillic_che; sleep 0.4  # RU физ.X (ч)
+xdotool key ctrl+cyrillic_te;  sleep 0.4  # RU физ.N (т)
+xdotool key cyrillic_ef;       sleep 0.4  # plain RU ф: d1 84
 setxkbmap -layout us,ru -option grp:alt_shift_toggle
-sleep 0.3; xdotool windowkill "$wid" 2>/dev/null
-echo "=== hexdump (эталон: 01,18 | ?? ?? ??,d184) ==="
-xxd "$OUT"
+sleep 0.3
+xdotool windowkill "$wid" 2>/dev/null
+echo "=== hexdump: эталон 01 18 |RU: d184 d187 d182 d184 (сломано) или 01 18 0e d184 (ctrl-фолбэк есть)==="
+xxd "$BIN" 2>/dev/null
